Jun 2024 – Sep 2024  •  Seattle, WA

Supply Chain Simulation Project (Senior Capstone):
Modeled distribution logistics for regional retail network in Python; predicted stockouts with 89% accuracy and won 2nd Place in Foster Business Case Showcase.
